provider: Panoramax federation — 25 instances with per-instance `registration_is_open` (ulm / osm-es / seespider / panoramax-ar / osm-hr / osm-be)

free_tier.stated: No quota on any instance (same codebase, same absence of a quota mechanism). The federation catalog itself is the useful artifact: `GET /api/instances` returns all 25 instances WITH each one's live configuration, including `registration_is_open`.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: each instance serves its own originals, unmetered, no auth

interface_detail: One shared STAC/OGC API shape across every instance. The same client works against all of them.
tooling: panoramax_cli --api-url <instance>; `panoramax_cli transfer` moves a sequence between instances without re-uploading from disk
chaining: Round-robin writes across the open instances; the federated meta-catalog at api.panoramax.xyz indexes all of them, so one search call sees every copy. Multiply capacity by instance count.
limits_note: Geo_coverage is enforced socially, not technically. IGN instance demands French territory; panorama.wales demands Wales; pano.locus.sbs demands US-NW. `panoramax-ulm.jjbaur.de` is the outlier: its config says verbatim 'Worldwide — The picture can be sent from anywhere in the world.'.

identity_cost.detail: email (OSM OAuth for most; Keycloak self-registration for seespider at auth.pycnogon.xyz; osm-es declares `user_profile.url = null`, i.e. its own local accounts)

reliability_note: Open=False on 11 of 25 instances (multimodall, bikespace, nl-test, osm-fulda, vee, multimob, serenedeluge, burakonder, mapcomplete, osm-tw). Two instances (mahdi, kasik-gis) have auth disabled entirely. Anonymous read, no upload path.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

evidence.proved: registration_is_open: true, geo_coverage 'Worldwide\nThe picture can be sent from anywhere in the world.'
registration_is_open true, own Keycloak realm, 'Photos must be located in France'

notes: No quota on any instance (same codebase, same absence of a quota mechanism). The federation catalog itself is the useful artifact: `GET /api/instances` returns all 25 instances WITH each one's live configuration, including `registration_is_open`.

Plus the relay/P2P half: signalling vs true relaying, and which free relays carry data.
